apps.name: General AI assistant + free scheduler
apps.whatItDoes: ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to write posts, menu descriptions, job ads, SOPs and roster drafts, paired with Meta Business Suite (free) for scheduling.
apps.why: The cheapest all-rounder. Needs some prompt templates to be useful, which is a natural toolkit item for the programme. Always check its output before it goes to customers.
apps.price: Free tiers · ~USD 20 / mo for a paid plan

apps.name: PostEverywhere
apps.whatItDoes: Schedules posts across Instagram, Facebook and Google Business Profile with AI captions per platform.
apps.why: Restaurant-focused and priced for one venue. Turns one photo of a special into a week of posts in under 30 minutes.

apps.name: RepliFast
apps.whatItDoes: AI Google review replies in the venue's voice. Can autopilot good reviews and route low ratings to a human.
apps.why: The split between auto-posting 5-star replies and holding back complaints is the right safety model. Free version available.

apps.name: ShiftTrained
apps.whatItDoes: Upload or photograph the menu; AI generates 100–400 quiz questions on ingredients, allergens, prices and pairings. Staff train on their phones by link, no app.
apps.why: Solves high-turnover menu training in minutes. Every plan includes every feature; price only scales with team size. Strong fit for the programme.
apps.price: USD 29 / 49 / 99 per mo (20 / 40 / 99 staff); free first menu

apps.name: Diced OS
apps.whatItDoes: iPhone/iPad app: photograph an invoice, AI pulls items and prices, build recipes and see real dish costs.
apps.why: Cheapest entry point found. Free up to 20 items, so a food truck or small café can start costing dishes the same day. Pairs well with the Menu Engineering Playbook.
apps.price: Free (20 items) · USD 19.99 / mo unlimited, 50 scans
apps.nz: App Store, confirm in NZ store

apps.name: Restoke
apps.whatItDoes: Snap or email supplier invoices; AI reads every line, updates ingredient prices and food cost, and sends bills to Xero. Pro adds inventory, recipe costing, ordering and kitchen procedures.
apps.why: Kills the weekly invoice data-entry job and catches supplier price creep. Listed for NZ in the Xero App Store. Best fit for food-led venues already on Xero.
